objective: Repair public Wall Android video fullscreen no-response on tap while preserving inline autoplay, clip Fill/Fit, playback resume and ad click behavior
productionBaselineEvidence: verified: Current GitHub main source inspected on 2026-11-17; native CommunityVideo includes ExpoVideo tap overlay and Public Wall has playlist lookup that can silently return for a just-visible post. This source evidence does not establish the installed Infinix X6852 build, staging OTA, production OTA or Android touch behavior.
chosenApproach: Prioritize fullscreen callback for offscreen previews, route Expo native touches through a single top overlay, show a discoverable fullscreen text target next to Fill, and use the already-visible post as fallback if the memoized video playlist has not included it yet.
selectionRationale: Small JS-only changes restore a reliable tap path and user-visible fallback without a native module rebuild, additional decoder, media signing, or intercepting IMA ad clicks.
alternativeApproaches: Use only a dedicated square fullscreen icon: rejected because tap-to-open remains a user requirement
Intercept IMA video ad touch: rejected because it would interfere with paid-ad clicks
acceptanceChecks: Regular Android Wall video opens fullscreen from a frame tap or the Full screen text action
Inactive/offscreen preview opens fullscreen instead of silently starting the inline player
Viewer targets visible clicked video even if memoized playlist is stale, then closes with Back/Close
Fill/Fit remains a separate crop control, sound and playback position remain unchanged
IMA ad clicks, private media authorization, preload and audio mixing remain untouched
Focused Node tests, engineering gates, TypeScript, staging Android QA and source fingerprint required before OTA; no production release is claimed
preserveBehaviors: Wall clips retain visible autoplay, duration, cache, signed URLs, poster, mute/unmute, retry and viewport budget
Fullscreen scroll and ad inventory; native IMA ad player remains individually clickable
Main app navigation, bottom tabs, profile and PTT audio isolation
